text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... huff... Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to make... the full 2,400
meters...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Nishino Flower is so
exhausted she
can't even move, so I
have her lie down for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I really am... so sorry I couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... if I had just tried a little harder,
and trained
instead of resting...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I put more thought into my physical
condition,
today could have been
different...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't say she was in peak condition
when she
took on today's race, but the
reason for her loss
lies elsewhere.
choice_data_list: 頑張ることは間違いじゃないよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next race, the Shuka Sho, is a

medium-distance race, like the one she
just ran.
However, considering today's
results...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was watching you run from up here.
You were so
wonderfully fast, just like a
cutting gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And when that blossom finally
blooms, we
will face each other on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are other races where Nishino
Flower can
make the best use of her
talents.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: フラワー、次のレースなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I didn't live up to your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's worked hard in the lead-up to
today's race.
With some further
adjustments, running in the
Shuka Sho
would also be a viable option.

However...
choice_data_list: 君は何も裏切ってない
貴方は何も裏切ってない

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Shine even brighter? What do you
mean?
choice_data_list: もっと輝ける舞台があるはず

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: この先は短距離で挑戦していかないか
この先は短距離で挑戦していかない？

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's actually a relief to hear that.
Honestly, I
already knew things might
come to this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Oaks is a big race, so I
wanted to
try my best for it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But it was a little too much for me, and
there were
times when things felt
incredibly tough...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Thank you too.
choice_data_list: 頑張ってくれてありがとう

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can perform even better in
sprints, so
let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... what should we set as my goal?
Considering
the season, should we aim
for a graded race in
the summer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her reasoning is sound. Running in one
of the
summer races of the sprint tour is
one way to get
her used to them, but
she can aim for something
even bigger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But isn't that a G1 race?!
choice_data_list: 『スプリンターズステークス』はどうかな

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You want me to run that right after
changing
course? Not to mention there'll
be senior-year
racers participating...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This will be Nishino Flower's first time
running in a
race with older competitors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Compared to them, I'm still just a kid,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Will I even stand a chance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower has always been
self-conscious
about how much younger
she is compared to
other racers, so I
understand why she's worried
about
running with older Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Not as I am right now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The academy's summer camp will be
starting
soon, and Umamusume tend to
make vast
improvements during that
time.
choice_data_list: 夏でもっと成長できる

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 俺も頑張るから、一緒に強くなろう！
私も頑張るから、一緒に強くなろう！

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Then I'll follow your lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to make our next
goal the G1
Sprinters Stakes.
